record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: For every graph G and every edge e of G, is χ⋆ℓ(G) ≤ χ⋆ℓ(G-e)+2, where χ⋆ℓ denotes the list packing number and G-e is the graph obtained by deleting e?

evidence.quote: Or, is it true that χ⋆ ℓ(G)≤χ⋆ ℓ(G\e) + 2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. A list assignment for $G$ is a function $L$ that assigns to each vertex $v\in V$ a set $L(v)$ of colors. For a positive integer $k$, a $k$-fold list assignment is one with $|L(v)|=k$ for all $v\in V$. Given a $k$-fold list assignment $L$, an $L$-packing is a collection $(c_1,c_2,\dots,c_k)$ of $k$ proper colorings of $G$ such that:
(i) for every vertex $v$, $c_i(v)\in L(v)$ for each $i$; and
(ii) for every vertex $v$, the colors $c_1(v),c_2(v),\dots,c_k(v)$ are pairwise distinct (i.e. $\{c_1(v),\dots,c_k(v)\}=L(v)$).
The list packing number $\chi^\star_\ell(G)$ is the smallest $k$ such that, for every $k$-fold list assignment $L$ for $G$, an $L$-packing exists.

For an edge $e\in E$, let $G-e$ denote the graph obtained from $G$ by deleting the edge $e$.

Question: Is it true that for every graph $G$ and every edge $e$ of $G$,
$$\chi^\star_\ell(G) \le \chi^\star_\ell(G-e) + 2\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem at the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings (2023). A direct web search for the specific inequality and for recent results on edge-deletion stability of the list packing number returned no resolution; related work (e.g. on well-definedness of $\chi^\star_\ell$) exists but does not settle this particular bound. No published solution was located.

status_evidence.title: A short proof that the list packing number of any graph is well defined
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes that $\chi^\star_\ell(G)$ is well defined for every graph G, but does not address the edge-deletion bound.
status_evidence.claim: Related foundational result on the list packing number; does not resolve the proposed inequality.

status_evidence.title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems including the question of whether $\chi^\star_\ell(G)\le \chi^\star_\ell(G-e)+2$.
status_evidence.claim: Problem is stated as open in the workshop's open-problem collection.
